title: Daily digest: Azharuddin distributes Indiramma House l | TG to engage Army officers on deputation | Keralam govt. directs KMSCL to expedite
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: Azharuddin distributes Indiramma House letters in Nampally.
TG to engage Army officers on deputation for SLBC tunnel, Kaleshwaram barrages rehab works.
Keralam govt. directs KMSCL to expedite medicine purchase orders.
bullets_ur: Azharuddin Nampally mein Indiramma House ke patte taqseem karte hain.
TG fauj ke afraad ko SLBC tunnel aur Kaleshwaram barrages ke rehab kaam ke liye deputation par shamil karega.
Keralam hukumat ne KMSCL ko medicine khareed orders mein tezi laane ki hidayat di.
